chapter_title: Concept of Mole and Chemical Calculation

sections.content_markdown:
In $1\text{ g}$ $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ the amount of $\text{H} = \frac{2}{18} \text{ g}$  
In $100\text{ g}$ $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ the amount of $\text{H} = \frac{2 \times 100}{18} = 11.11\text{ g}$  
So, the percent composition of $\text{H}$ in $\text{HCl}$ is $11.11\%$.  
Again, the percent composition of $\text{O}$ is $(100 - 11.11) = 88.89\%$.  
We can determine the same percent composition applying values in the formula of percentage composition.  
$$\text{Percent composition of an element in a compound} = \frac{\text{atomic mass of element} \times \text{number of atoms} \times 100}{\text{molecular mass of compound}}\%$$  
The molecular mass of $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4 = (1 \times 2 + 32 \times 1 + 16 \times 4) = 98$  
Here, atomic mass of $\text{H}$ is $1$ and the number of $\text{H}$ atoms is $2$  
Therefore, the percent composition of $\text{H} = \frac{1 \times 2 \times 100}{98}\% = 2.04\%$  
Atomic mass of $\text{S}$ is $32$ and the number of $\text{S}$ atoms is $1$  
Therefore, the percent composition of $\text{S} = \frac{32 \times 1 \times 100}{98}\% = 32.65\%$  
Atomic mass of $\text{O}$ is $16$ and the number of $\text{O}$ atoms is $4$  
Therefore, the percent composition of $\text{O} = \frac{16 \times 4 \times 100}{98}\% = 65.3\%$

**Problem:** Find out the percent composition of aluminum, sulfur and oxygen in $\text{Al}_2(\text{SO}_4)_3$  
**Solution:** The molecular mass of $\text{Al}_2(\text{SO}_4)_3 = 27 \times 2 + (32 \times 1 + 16 \times 4) \times 3 = 342$  
the percent composition of $\text{Al} = \frac{27 \times 2 \times 100}{342}\% = 15.78\%$  
the percent composition of $\text{S} = \frac{32 \times 3 \times 100}{342}\% = 28.07\%$  
the percent composition of $\text{O} = \frac{16 \times 12 \times 100}{342}\% = 56.14\%$
**Task:** Find out the percent composition of $\text{Na}$ and $\text{Cl}$ in $\text{NaCl}$.
